race.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
race.verdict: Preference is for 7-time C&D winner Paddy's Day , who has got back on track returned to this venue on his last 2 starts. He is fancied to take advantage of his reduced mark, though Changeofmind remains unexposed on all-weather and heads the list of dangers, ahead of the in-form Kinetic Force . PADDY'S DAY (IRE) CHANGEOFMIND (IRE) KINETIC FORCE
